evidence: Checks the global camera-core pointer at 0x7002b40278. If already non-null it returns; if null it allocates 0x18d8 bytes, calls initialize_camera_core_state, and stores the returned object pointer in the global slot. Its caller invokes this during startup dispatch. decompiled/main/main_0031.c:11746-11769; caller decompiled/main/main_0000.c:5231-5233.

Initializes a local output byte, passes its address and two zero arguments to evaluate_nested_attribute_candidates, then returns true when either that helper's result or the output byte is nonzero. Repeated callers use the result as a predicate while supplying selector values. decompiled/main/main_0032.c:41959-41980; caller decompiled/main/main_0033.c:48918-48920.

Loads a pointer from input+0x290 and, only when non-null, calls the accepted load_live_roster_pack_if_needed helper with that pointer and a zero flag. It then returns void. A nearby wrapper tail-calls this routine in a live-roster flow. decompiled/main/main_0071.c:4376-4390; caller decompiled/main/main_0071.c:4370-4374.

Calls the accepted write_audio_memory_map_dump routine, requests an object through the allocator helper, and when the result is non-null stores the 32-bit value 7 at returned_object+0x8. Its caller tail-calls this wrapper after a related resource cleanup path. decompiled/main/main_0076.c:2861-2881; caller decompiled/main/main_0083.c:47168-47169.

Sets x1 to zero, calls resolve_attribute_context_status_value, then tail-calls a second lookup helper with the resulting value in x0. Its caller uses the result in a status-derived record calculation, but the exact relationship between the context resolver and following lookup is unclear; leave unnamed. decompiled/main/main_0035.c:6324-6337; caller decompiled/main/main_0036.c:48795-48797.
